about: A statechart hands imported algorithms values that may be absent and holds the ones they give back (docs/adr/0055): goals whose `day` may be absent are kept in `goals`, a list of records, and each one that comes in is appended, then `Earliest` answers the earliest day of the list (absent when no goal has one: an optional local, `.value` read where a test in the same condition proves it present, an optional return), `Until` the days from `today` (100) to that day (an optional parameter, an early return of `null` that proves it present after it, an optional return), `Undated` how many goals have no day (the list filtered by a test of the optional field) and `DaySum` the days added up, a goal with no day counted as 0 (`??` in the body). `until.none` hands `Until` the literal `null` and takes back an absent value; `until.at` hands it 150, an int64 lifted into the optional parameter. A fifth goal does not fit the four the list holds: the append fails, nothing after it runs, and error.execution is raised. `clear` empties the list, and every algorithm answers what an empty list is. A variable's int64 is a number, and a record field's int64 the text of its digits; an absent value is `null`. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: nothing yet: `first` starts absent and `left` present
a goal with no day: no goal has a day, so the earliest is absent, and an absent day handed to Until answers absent; one goal is undated and counts 0 in the sum
a goal due on day 130: it is the earliest, 30 days from today, and the sum is its day
a goal due on day 115 is earlier than 130
a goal due on day 90, before today: the earliest, and 10 days past
`null` handed to Until: an absent value passed in, and an absent value taken back
150 handed to Until: a value of int64 lifted into the optional parameter, read as 50 days from today
a fifth goal does not fit: the append fails, nothing after it runs, and error.execution says so
the list emptied: no earliest day, so Until answers absent, none undated and a sum of 0
